name: app-cream-real-estate-app-on-tan-leather-sofa
title: Cream Real Estate App on Leather Sofa
whatItIs: A gold-framed phone leaning against tan leather cushions, showing a cream home screen with a friendly greeting, avatars of neighbourhoods, a search bar and property cards.
whatItMeans: The leather and warm cream palette suggest comfort and home. A tactile setting makes the app feel personal.
techniques: Real-world furniture as a stage matching the product theme
Warm neutral UI colours drawn from the scene
Soft window light across the leather
Phone leaning rather than lying flat
Small logo bottom right as sign-off

vocabulary.definition: A physical setting chosen to echo the product's theme.
A phone propped upright against an object.
A beige, cream or tan used as a base colour.
